title: Number 137 in the proportions of the second pyramid

tellings.quote: You surely haven't failed to notice the correspondence with the number found in the proportions of the second pyramid of Giza.

plain: A researcher named Armando Mei, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that the number 137 shows up in the proportions of the second pyramid of Giza in Egypt. He links it to the same number as discussed by the physicists Richard Feynman and Leon Lederman. If true, it would suggest the pyramid's builders knew something about the deep workings of nature.
